annotation.title_clean: Blueprint to Action: China's Path to AI-Powered Industry Transformation
annotation.title_en: Blueprint to Action: China's Path to AI-Powered Industry Transformation
annotation.authors_or_issuer: World Economic Forum (AI Governance Alliance); Accenture
annotation.summary_en: WEF/Accenture white paper (Jan 2025) describing China's AI-powered industry transformation: national strategy, adaptive regulation balancing development and safety, multi-level policy, ecosystem enablers (infrastructure, data, models, energy, talent), and industry use cases incl. manufacturing, autonomous transport, retail and finance, plus key challenges.
key_provisions_or_claims: China's AI core industry exceeds $70 billion with over 4,300 companies, targeting $140 billion by 2030
Government support, ecosystem enablers and industrial application drive AI transformation
China uses adaptive regulations balancing development, safety and governance
Use cases span industrial manufacturing, autonomous transportation, retail, finance, energy and public services
An open, collaborative ecosystem is needed to address remaining challenges
